subject: info-doc
title: INFO.DOC.-----AFL.DYM.------T.C.IMP.
description: Triple-crossing diagram on page 223 (T(IMP)M-21), paired with STF × PROJ-DY above. The triple-axis names what black-improvised-music's information-documentation structurally requires when both affinity-dynamics *and* time-continuum-implications are working partners: (PO)INFO-DOC (the point of information documentation) crossed with AFL-DYM (affinity dynamics — the middle axis) crossed with T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). INFO-DOC sits at upper-left with the subject-arrow and the (po) prefix, 'point of'. AFL-DYM (the middle axis) sits at upper-right. T-C-IMP sits at lower-right as partner-axis. TH-CONT (thrust continuance) sits centrally, on a line that descends from the INFO-DOC–AFL-DYM line. AFL-DY-INT (written 'afl.dy.int.') ends that line at the bottom-left, below TH-CONT. Structurally, the main line runs from INFO-DOC to AFL-DYM and turns down to T-C-IMP; TH-CONT and AFL-DY-INT lie on a separate line from the INFO-DOC–AFL-DYM stretch.
